findings.problem: Long original-source hashes and paths could force the flex source card wider than the visible panel.
findings.mitigation: Allow source-card text to shrink and wrap provenance strings; bound material-property table columns. Keep applicability in a sibling disclosure outside the original PSI series. No scoring change.

findings.problem: Mixing third-party property data into PSI records could falsely attribute measurements, inflate proximity or permit unsupported citations.
findings.mitigation: Use an optional, validated MAT sidecar. Keep all third-party context outside sources/evidence, tables, trial rows and material suggestions. Provide a separate applicability object and UI subsection. No numerical scoring change.

findings.problem: A PP source metadata file names polypropylene but its short description names PVC. Exact material identity is contradictory.
findings.mitigation: Exclude the candidate from active profiles; retain six original points in quarantined-profiles.json and leave polypropylene coverage pending. Do not silently choose a polymer.

findings.problem: Conductivity curves, family labels and specimen temperatures do not establish environmental combustion tolerances or equal burning.
findings.mitigation: Keep all adjustments disabled. Expose grade/geometry/conditioning and uncertainty gaps. PMMA thickness, cotton construction and nylon-grade inconsistencies remain explicit. No source-family data are substituted for SIBAL, paper, fiberglass or other uncovered materials.

findings.problem: The active cohort covers 11 conductivity profiles /66 points/7 families.22 of29 material coverage rows remain pending; volumetric heat-capacity units do not satisfy the mass-specific v1 schema.
findings.mitigation: Retain originals in Third_Party. Add independently reviewed property/axis adapters with explicit units/phase and source checks; do not force unknown values through the existing adapter. No new model training or external web retrieval.

standardsStatus: NPR7150.2D Class C remains an incomplete engineering target, not certification.
